description:
When the Apple family finds a college acceptance letter addressed to Big Mac in the mail, they suspect something must be wrong because members of the Apple family are really stupid. Princess Celestia confesses that the reality of the situation is that Big Mac has been chosen to go on a top secret mission alongside Twilight Sparkle, Rarity, and other select ponies where they must infiltrate a certain campus and bring a certain individual back in handcuffs.
